claims.text: The U.S. goods and services deficit was $68.9 billion in February 2024, up $1.3 billion from the revised January deficit of $67.6 billion.

citations.quotation: The U.S. Census Bureau and the U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis announced today that the goods and services deficit was $68.9 billion in February, up $1.3 billion from $67.6 billion in January, revised.

claims.text: February exports were $263.0 billion, an increase of $5.8 billion from January, and February imports were $331.9 billion, an increase of $7.1 billion from January.

citations.quotation: February exports were $263.0 billion, $5.8 billion more than January exports. February imports were $331.9 billion, $7.1 billion more than January imports.

claims.text: The February increase in the overall deficit reflected a decrease in the goods deficit of $0.3 billion to $91.4 billion and a decrease in the services surplus of $1.6 billion to $22.5 billion; the smaller services surplus more than offset the slight narrowing of the goods deficit.

citations.quotation: The February increase in the goods and services deficit reflected a decrease in the goods deficit of $0.3 billion to $91.4 billion and a decrease in the services surplus of $1.6 billion to $22.5 billion.

claims.text: Year-to-date, the goods and services deficit decreased $3.9 billion, or 2.8 percent, from the same period in 2023.

citations.quotation: Year-to-date, the goods and services deficit decreased $3.9 billion, or 2.8 percent, from the same period in 2023.
